title: Protocol to Generate Traceable CAR T Cells for Mouse Cancer Models
author: Zhang, Krimitza, et al.
materials: EasySep Mouse T Cell Isolation Kit

steps.title: Synthesize polycistronic traceable CAR vector
steps.instruction: Generate the pMMLV‑Egfrviii‑CAR‑T2A‑mTagBFP2‑P2A‑nLuc plasmid that encodes the 139 scFv CAR, the monomeric blue fluorescent protein (mTagBFP2) and nano‑luciferase (nLuc) in a single open reading frame separated by 2A peptide sequences.

steps.title: Inject EGFRvIII+ glioblastoma cells into mice
steps.instruction: Perform an orthotopic stereotactic injection of 1 × 10^5 EGFRvIII+ GL261 glioblastoma cells in 1 µL PBS into each ~8‑week‑old recipient mouse; 10 days later confirm tumor growth by IVIS after retro‑orbital injection of 50 µL D‑luciferin solution per mouse and plan CAR‑T infusion for 12–15 days post‑tumor injection.

steps.title: Isolate and activate mouse CD3+ T cells
steps.instruction: Isolate CD3+ T cells from donor spleens, activate them on anti‑CD3/CD28‑coated plates, and expand for 48 h before transduction.

substeps.instruction: Determine number of donor mice; one donor supplies enough splenocytes for 8–10 recipients (each will receive 5 × 10^6 transduced CAR T cells).
Coat non‑treated 6‑well plates overnight (12–16 h at 4 °C) with 1.5 mL PBS containing 5 µg/mL anti‑mouse CD3 antibody and 5 µg/mL anti‑mouse CD28 antibody per well; seal with Parafilm.
Euthanize donor mice (follow institutional guidelines) and spray bodies with 70 % (vol %) ethanol.
Place each spleen in 2 mL MACS isolation buffer on ice in a sterile 6 cm dish.
Cut spleens into 1–2 mm pieces and pass through a pre‑rinsed 70 µm sterile cell strainer over a 50 mL conical tube, rinsing the strainer with 20 mL MACS buffer.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL MACS buffer per spleen.
Isolate CD3+ T cells using the EasySep mouse T cell isolation kit:
• Add 20 µL FcR blocker to each 1 mL suspension containing 1 × 10^8 cells.
• Transfer ≤4 mL of the suspension to a 15 mL conical tube.
• Add 50 µL Isolation Cocktail per 1 mL suspension and mix.
• Incubate 10 min at room temperature (20–22 °C).
• Vortex RapidSpheres 30 s, then add 75 µL RapidSpheres per 1 mL suspension and mix.
• Incubate 2.5 min at room temperature.
• Top up each tube with MACS buffer to 5 mL if volume <4 mL, or to 9 mL if ≥4 mL.
• Place tube in magnet for 2.5 min at room temperature; pour enriched CD3+ cells into a fresh tube.
Count enriched T cells (expect 25–30 % of splenocytes, ~6–12 × 10^7 T cells per mouse).
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend cells in T cell medium (TCM) at 1.5 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Rinse the antibody‑coated 6‑well plates with PBS (do not let wells dry).
Add 2–3 mL of the TCM‑suspended T cells to each coated well and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 48 h.
Monitor activation: if medium turns yellow, add 1 mL fresh TCM per well; enlarged cells and clusters indicate successful activation.

steps.title: Assess CAR T‑cell transduction by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Measure fluorescent reporter (mTagBFP2) and CAR surface expression on transduced T cells 48–72 h after transduction using Alexa Fluor 647‑conjugated anti‑human Fab antibody and propidium iodide viability staining.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize transduced CAR T cells and no‑virus control cells; aliquot 100 µL of each into a 1.5 mL tube.
Add 900 µL PBS, vortex briefly, and centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min.
Discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 100 µL MACS buffer containing Alexa Fluor 647‑conjugated goat anti‑human Fab antibody diluted 1:200.
Incubate 20 min at room temperature (20–22 °C) on an orbital shaker ≤300 rpm, protected from light.
Add 900 µL PBS, vortex briefly, and centrifuge again at 500 × g for 5 min.
Discard supernatant and resuspend cells in 300 µL MACS buffer.
Transfer to a 5 mL round‑bottom flow cytometry tube.
Add 5 µL of 10 µg/mL propidium iodide (PI) solution, mix, and proceed immediately to flow cytometer acquisition.
Analyze data: gate debris (FSC‑A vs SSC‑A), singlets (SSC‑A vs SSC‑H), live cells (PI‑negative), then calculate % mTagBFP2⁺/CAR⁺ double‑positive cells (expected 30‑50 %).

steps.title: Perform statistical analysis of experimental data
steps.instruction: Analyze CAR T‑cell cytotoxicity with two‑way ANOVA and Dunnett’s multiple‑comparison test in GraphPad Prism 9; process flow cytometry data in FlowJo v10; visualize IVIS images with Living Image v4.8.

description:
Note: This protocol outlines the procedure of expressing a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) using a Moloney murine leukemia (MMLV) retroviral vector, integrated with a nano-luciferase (nLuc) and fluorescent protein tracing system. This system facilitates the tracking of CAR T cell infiltration and localization in syngeneic mouse cancer models through a bioluminescence-based in vivo imaging system. The specific CAR construct employed in this protocol incorporates the 139 scFv,2,3 targeting the Egfrviii—a glioblastoma (GBM)-associated variant of the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR). Following the protocol, we administered CAR T immunotherapy to mice with syngeneic GL261 GBM tumors expressing murine Egfrviii. This approach holds promise for various CAR-antigen combinations, animal models, and transgene carrier vectors. The whole procedure will take about 2 weeks to complete (Figure 1).
